ProblemDescription: Example problem description captured from an HSD ticket. Replace this text with the concise issue narrative from the target ticket.
SystemConfigurationAndReproductionStep: Example reproduction setup, system configuration, software versions, and the minimum steps required to reproduce the issue.
RootCause: Example root cause summary. Replace with the confirmed technical cause from the ticket, or state that it is not explicitly available.
FinalSolution: Example fix or workaround summary from the ticket.
AffectedProducts: Example platform or product list from the ticket.
Severity: Example severity or priority value from the ticket.
Comments: Example comments or caveats. Use this field for supporting notes, limitations, or follow-up details from the ticket.
